blocking_findings: Hash closure and manifest still bind v2.2 artifacts.
Validator rewrites reviewed inputs and validates declarations/counts rather than effects.
Recovery remains a second root with incomplete edges/fencing.
AP20-AP25 do not exist and X41 violates app-config bootstrap ownership.
Trace/tests are inherited round-robin v2.2 placeholders; mutations/assets and release identity remain unresolved.
Negative vectors are metadata with identical declared pre/post hashes, not executed tests.
Mutation records are unsigned synthetic strings without authenticated linkage or target bytes.
U01-U08 recovery transitions are absent.
Candidate, Vault, CNPG, proxy, signer, and admin contracts are not evaluated.
Pass-stage council checks only GO plus one report hash.
App-config bootstrap and seven-lane GitOps ownership are not established.
DEV lacks three-node N-1 and Kata; controller is CrashLoopBackOff and applications are unhealthy.
Prod context is unreachable and CNPG/network/failover evidence is incomplete.
Artifact/release versions are inconsistent and v0.6.14 is absent amid v0.7.x releases.
The retained v0.6.8 recovery workflow currently fails required identity arguments.
Validator checks only counts/declarations and regenerates inputs.
All negatives reuse one base and mostly one invalid payload patch; none measures effects.
Mutation records lack nonce, time, signatures, and concrete identities.
FSM recovery edges, semantic traceability, and current hash closure are missing.
Pass-stage council closure is forgeable and non-mandatory.

consensus.summary: All four lanes rejected v2.3 because it regressed exact-hash closure, retained placeholder traceability, used a mutating non-semantic validator, did not execute negative effects or signed mutation chains, left recovery/bootstrap disconnected, and conflicts with unhealthy live prerequisites.
